no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an ODAC as no clinical efficacy or safety issues arose that required an advisory committee meeting and discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the EMPLICITI (elotuzumab) BLA761035 approval. The Division Director's ODMemo states the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because no clinical efficacy or safety issues arose that required an advisory committee meeting, and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review ('No advisory committee') and Medical review ('This Application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants') corroborate this. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
